LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic document upload component. Replaces object-specific file upload components. Configure card title, subtitle, and object API name from the App Builder property panel.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Id of the record to attach files to. Pass the flow's recordId variable.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Header title shown on the component card.

property.name: cardSubtitle
property.label: Card Subtitle
property.description: Subtitle shown under the card title.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object (e.g. Account). Used to filter document types.
